questions.question_text:
Amil earns £9.75 per hour.
He works 7.5 hours a day Monday to Thursday and 7 hours on Friday.
Without using a calculator, what is his weekly salary?

options.why: Multiplies the hourly rate by ten too many after finding the weekly hours.
Multiplies the hourly rate by an incorrect total number of hours.
Omits some of the weekday hours from the weekly total.

questions.solution_text: The total hours are $4(7.5)+7=37$. Thus the weekly salary is $37\times£9.75=£360.75$.
